program.name: Hotel Room
program.subject: Bodyweight
program.blurb: Only a mat or a towel. Full-body circuits for trips and days away from your weights.
program.about: Only a mat or a towel needed: full-body circuits for trips and days away from your weights. Two circuits alternate, each about 25 minutes of bodyweight work. Level II adds reps and Level III slows the lowering to three seconds. For keeping the habit on the road.
